objects: [{ref, identity:string|{state,value|family|category}, participates?, refinement?|identity_refinement?, subtype?, product_family?, attached_to?, why?, kind?, note?}]

transformations.RENAME: key names of the prompt vocabulary → contract keys (value untouched)
transformations.UNWRAP: {state,value} envelopes → contract value forms (OBSERVED→value · ABSENT/UNKNOWN→token · NOT_VISIBLE→{state,limitation[]})
transformations.REPRESENTATION_MULTI_TO_ARRAY / REPRESEN: governed MULTI facts are arrays; non-MULTI one-element arrays become scalars (representation, never a value change)
transformations.PART_TOKEN_MAPPED_EXACT: a free-text colour part that EQUALS a Colour V1 / Item token (case-insensitive) → carrier_part; any other text is logged and NOT mapped
transformations.DEFAULT_PARTICIPATES_FROM_LISTING: an object the model listed among its components with no participates field → participant (logged)
transformations.ATTRIBUTION_UNKNOWN_FROM_NULL: exposure attribution null → UNKNOWN (the prompt's own rule for an undetermined cause)
transformations.IDENTITY_OUTSIDE_VOCABULARY_KEPT_AS_UNKN: Prompt V1.2 §3 rule applied; raw text kept in the log
transformations.NOT_EMITTED: applicable facts / colour entries the model did not emit are listed; the pool reads them as UNKNOWN — never ABSENT
transformations.UNCONVERTIBLE: anything the contract cannot carry without inventing or substituting (value outside its governed domain, OBSERVED without value, null value, unknown fact name, state outside domain, non-realized exposure rows, top-level keys outside the contract) — raw kept, not emitted

never: convert a missing field into ABSENT
